verdict.rationale: Runloop has a dedicated first-party Network Policies docs page described as controlling egress network access for Devboxes, so the product itself offers explicit egress policy. The evidence is only a one-line page summary, so how policies are defined and enforced is unproven. missing for 10: details of allow/deny rule semantics (domains, IPs, ports), how policies are attached to devboxes or blueprints, default-deny behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration that enforcement works.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can restrict or allow the sandbox's network egress with explicit policy

citations.quote: Control egress network access for your Devboxes
